acceptance_rule: Choose actual fired Berea core/slab batch or explicitly choose a packed-sand slab; record batch/preparation.
Use measured cell/specimen dimensions; old 1.2 m x 0.1 m x 0.1 m abstract geometry is forbidden.
Measure the actual specimen/pack; literature values are priors only.
Measure actual specimen by Darcy flow.
Check at 360/374/380 C and 25-30 MPa or justify why ambient k is invariant.
Determine accessible PV at operating T/P; use it for PVI/rate scaling.
Water-wet is only a prior until target-T/P evidence or an explicit sensitivity decision is recorded.
Stage-1 Corey curves are sensitivity parameters, not calibration. Either obtain data or retain uncertainty ensemble in all flow conclusions.
Current Natural flux has no explicit phase capillary-pressure closure; implement it or demonstrate a Pc=0 regime by dimensionless/pressure-drop evidence.
Repeat phi/k and material checks after SCW exposure.
Laboratory-reproducible porous-medium definition is not yet accepted for flow.
